title: Wardrobe and Radiators
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Sable Lockridge, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
